description: search-hole dependency updates: exact pins, two-week minimum release age (MASTER_PLAN §14 versions rule), nothing automerged.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the queue but still wait 3 days (the npm unpublish window) and are never automerged.

packageRules.description: Group dev-only minor and patch updates across the workspace into one PR.
UI runtime libraries (bundled into the dashboard and panel) get their own group.
GitHub Actions: pinned to commit SHAs with the version in a comment; grouped.
Toolchain (.mise.toml, packageManager, the mise version CI installs): one PR, reviewed by hand.
Node majors change the development runtime (ADR-0002); propose them separately.
engines.node is the support floor decided in ADR-0002, not a dependency to bump.
The npm name placeholders are published once by hand and never updated.
Major updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard.

customManagers.description: Versions pinned in workflow YAML with a trailing '# renovate:' comment (mise, Claude Code).
